title: Could a Fiber Supplement Help Chronic Knee Pain? - Nautilus
gist: Paywall-truncated piece on a University of Nottingham study in Nutrients. It suggests that inulin, a dietary fiber usually extracted from chicory, may give modest relief from chronic knee pain through the gut microbiome. Roughly a quarter of people in the US are estimated to have chronic knee pain.
